measure: Time relative to orjson; lower is better; orjson is 1.0
method: For each case, use summary[case].over_orjson[build], the saved median of seven process ratios. Each process ratio is the median of three paired jsonmodem/orjson timings. Compute exp(mean(log(case_ratio))) with equal weight per case.
scope: All primary complete-document cases. Input types and call wrappers count separately, including payloads repeated across scripts. Excludes controls, attribution experiments, streaming APIs and rejected candidates. Not application-weighted performance.
